title.sr: Preuzimanje naloga posle kupovine bez prijave (telefon)
title.en: Claiming an account after a guest purchase (phone)

intro.sr: Gost koji je zakazao ili kupio bez naloga otvara link iz mejla, bira lozinku, preuzima nalog i prijavljuje se. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: A guest who booked or bought without an account opens the email link, chooses a password, claims the account and logs in. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
